answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 24839 Country: India Title: I have got huge loans taken by me for business purpose. The business is in loss and the loan is mounting.The bank is after me to pay the loans and I am unable to pay the same. Please advise me duas so that I could pay the loans and be in peace. Question: Dear Muftisab, I have got huge loans taken by me for business purpose. The business is in loss and the loan is mounting.The bank is after me to pay the loans and I am unable to pay the same. Please advise me duas so that I could pay the loans and be in peace. Thanking You, Regards, Irfan Answer ID: 24839 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1352/1352/M=1431) You should put the matter of your loss before the bank and request them for appropriate time limit. Also, recite the following dua in the morning and evening daily: اللهم اكفنى بحلالك عن حرامك و اغننى بفضلك عمن سواك . Also keep on reciting durood extensively. May Almighty Allah free you from the burden of debt! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
